note: What a campaign may score, by name. The campaign file says which of these run and on what; this says where each one lives and what it is. Published quantizations are named by repository and revision and are read out of the Hugging Face cache; ours are directories we wrote under RUN_BASE.

baseline.why: The paired arm every candidate is measured against. A100 dequantizes it where H200 runs it natively, so a baseline scored on one cluster cannot be inherited by a candidate on the other.

fp8gdn.why: Ours: W4A16 AWQ with the 96 linear-attention projections in FP8.

bf16gdn.why: Ours: the same W4A16 AWQ weights with those projections left in bf16.
